verdictScope: No actual display defect was observed in the eight supplied whole images at their presented scales. This PASS applies only to visible saved-image rendering, not source fidelity, science, model correctness, choice semantics, Chinese approval, or live interaction.

observations: The Exercise 6 heading, chapter/page metadata, and blue Exercises navigation button are legible and aligned in the centered content column.
The metadata fits on one line. The button label, count, and arrow are contained within the button with no visible clipping or collisions.
The remaining image is largely blank; no body prose is visible on this saved surface. Content completeness is outside this display-only judgment.
limitations: The saved image shows only the resting navigation appearance; its destination, click behavior, and focus states were not tested.

observations: The title and metadata are separated from the exercise list. All eleven numbered blocks are visible in the whole image, including the end of item 11 and the Back to text button.
Wrapped prose stays inside the content column with consistent indentation and line spacing. Long items 2, 8, 9, 10, and 11 show no visible right-edge loss or overlapping lines.
Horizontal rules separate blocks without striking through text. The final navigation button has clear space above and below it.
limitations: The long whole-page presentation supports a layout and general readability assessment, not a guarantee about every fine glyph or antialiasing detail at native resolution.
The Back to text button was inspected visually only.

observations: Exercise 6 and Answers headings are distinct. Answer numbers 1 through 11, their prose blocks, and the final paragraph are visible with consistent margins and section separation.
The inline pressure expression in answer 9 sits within its paragraph without a visible collision with the lines above or below.
Answer 10's fraction expression, units, and raised exponents have visible surrounding space. Answer 11's pressure, mass, and unit expressions remain within the text column with no apparent clipping.
No raw formula command text, missing-glyph boxes, overlapping section headings, or cut-off final lines are apparent at the presented scale.
limitations: This is a very long saved page. Small subscripts, superscripts, fraction strokes, and individual glyph fidelity are not certified by a single whole-image view.
Formula layout was judged visually; no mathematical correctness or source/model comparison was performed.

observations: All six numbered choice groups are visible and separated by horizontal rules; the last group's final option and bottom whitespace are present.

The first group's six checkbox rows a through f have distinct control, letter, and prose columns. Its long option text wraps beneath the prose column without running into a control, another option, or the next question.
Radio controls in groups 2 through 5 and checkboxes in group 6 are visually distinct from their labels. Multi-line options retain clear vertical separation.
Group 4's inline energy expression, group 5's pressure expressions, and group 6's fraction options fit within their respective rows without visible collisions or clipping.
limitations: Only the saved unchecked/unselected appearance is evidenced. Selection, label activation, hit areas, keyboard access, feedback, and persistence were not exercised.
Long-image viewing does not establish native-resolution fidelity of every small formula glyph. No option truth or selection semantics were reviewed.

observations: The Exercise 6 heading is readable with a visible left margin. The chapter metadata wraps onto a second line for Printed page 111 rather than extending beyond the right edge.
The Exercises button is fully visible, and its count and arrow stay within its blue background. The heading, metadata, and button do not overlap.
The large blank remainder has no visible clipped fragment; no body prose is visible on this surface, and completeness is not inferred from it.
limitations: A single saved mobile width does not establish behavior at other widths or zoom levels.
Navigation was not activated, and no touch or focus behavior is certified.

observations: Exercise 6 and Exercises fit together in the heading, while the chapter/page metadata wraps into two legible lines without colliding with the first divider.

All eleven numbered exercise blocks remain visible. Their narrower prose column wraps into ordinary multi-word lines, with a stable indentation and visible right margin rather than horizontal clipping.
Long items 2, 8, 9, 10, and 11 retain separated lines and section boundaries. The final sentence of item 11 is visible above a fully contained Back to text button.
Occasional short final lines do not overlap adjacent sections or obscure numbering; no actual wrap fault is apparent.
limitations: The tall whole-page image was inspected once without zoom, cropping, or reopening; the assessment does not certify every punctuation mark or fine glyph at native resolution.
Scrolling experience and the navigation button's live behavior were not tested.

observations: The whole presented image includes both headings, answer numbers 1 through 11, and the final paragraph. Prose blocks preserve visible margins and clear section spacing throughout.

Answer 9's inline pressure expression remains inside the narrow paragraph. Answer 10's multi-fraction expression fits on its visible line with space around it and no apparent overlap with adjacent prose.

Answer 11 wraps its pressure expressions onto separate lines, retaining separation between expressions and neighboring text. Its mass, conversion, and unit expressions appear contained within the column.
At the reduced presentation scale, no gross clipping, heading collision, merged paragraph lines, or cut-off bottom content is visible.
limitations: The tool explicitly resized this image from 390x9161 to 255x6000 pixels. Its reduced text size is a review-display limitation, not evidence that the original mobile page uses undersized text.

General prose and layout are assessable, but native-size readability and exact small subscript, superscript, punctuation, and fraction-stroke fidelity cannot be certified from this scaled single view.
No native-resolution reopen, crop, derived image, browser inspection, or interaction was performed.

observations: The headings, all six question groups, and the final option of group 6 are visible. Wrapped question prose stays within the visible margins and does not collide with dividers.

The first group's six options a through f have fully visible checkbox outlines and letter labels. Long option prose wraps in its own indented column with separation between rows; the visible line break after tin- in option a is not a clipped word.
Radio options in groups 2 through 5 maintain distinct controls and labels despite additional mobile wrapping. Group 5's formula-led options fit and retain space between their multiple lines.
Group 4's inline energy expression and group 6's two stacked-fraction options have visible surrounding space. Group 6's prose options wrap above the bottom whitespace without a cut-off final line.
No visible text/control collision, overlapping options, formula overflow, or horizontal clipping was observed.
limitations: The tool explicitly resized this image from 390x6090 to 384x6000 pixels. This slight reduction still prevents an unqualified native-pixel glyph-fidelity claim.
All controls are shown in a resting unselected state. Touch targets, label activation, selection changes, feedback, keyboard access, and scrolling behavior are outside saved-pixel evidence.
Only display was reviewed; the repaired first question's correctness and choice semantics were not assessed.
PASS means no observed actual defect within this bounded saved-display inspection, not complete verification of the live application.
Every supplied image was independently opened exactly once with view_image. There were no reopens, crops, derived images, or other image-file reads.
Tall whole-image presentations limit fine-glyph assessment, especially the explicitly downscaled mobile answers image. No claim is made that every glyph was resolved at native resolution.
Static images cannot verify scrolling, pointer or touch activation, navigation destinations, keyboard focus, accessibility semantics, choice interaction, or any state absent from the screenshots.
Only the supplied desktop and mobile captures were inspected; other widths, zoom settings, loading states, and runtime behavior are not covered.
Input metadata was copied unchanged from inputs.json; image byte counts and hashes were not independently recomputed.
Source fidelity, science, model correctness, choice semantics, and Chinese-approved evidence were not reviewed or changed.
